text:
hannah.lee: FYI found a month-end revrec issue for customer ClearPath (contract CL-3050-09). Looks like a downgrade mid-cycle triggered proration that accelerated recognition; $46,200 of prepaid revenue was recognized this period but should be deferred. Affected invoices: INV-3050-91, INV-3050-92. Need JE guidance and confirmation before we close books.

omar.reed: ouch. Do you know how the downgrade flow accelerated recognition?

hannah.lee: short version: customer downgraded seats mid-month. Billing ran proration and the engine reduced the deferred balance based on remaining term incorrectly (treated full-month proration as immediate recognition). The commit proration routine should have deferred the remaining value, not recognize it.

jen.santos: can you paste the calculation and the query you used so I can pull GL lines?

hannah.lee: calc pasted below and SQL to trace applied proration: 
Total prepaid: 184,800
Recognized in ledger this period (actual): 138,600
Expected recognized to date: 92,400
Over-recognized: 46,200

SQL:
```sql
SELECT ap.invoice_id, ap.amount_applied, ap.reason_code, i.posted_date
FROM billing.applied_prorations ap
JOIN billing.invoices i on ap.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE ap.contract_id='CL-3050-09'
ORDER BY i.posted_date;
```

billing-bot: billing-bot: PRORATE RUN 1923452000: proration job applied downgrade proration to invoices INV-3050-91/92. Logs: /var/log/billing/prorate/1923452000.log

elaine.ops: recommend reversing JE: debit Revenue (GL 4000) 46,200; credit Deferred Revenue (GL 2005) 46,200. Memo: "Correction of accelerated recognition due to mid-cycle downgrade proration on CL-3050-09." Need approvals and JE posted before close.

omar.reed: approve the JE. Please include the billing run log and the worksheet with per-line calculations in the JE attachment. I'll run GL confirm after posting.

hannah.lee: uploaded worksheet: https://redwood-internal.s3/finance/CL-3050-09_downgrade_proration_workbook.csv

jen.santos: we should also run a sweep for other mid-cycle downgrades in the month. If systemic, could be material. I'll run a query to find contracts with proration entries and compare recognized vs expected.

billing-bot: SWEEP: quick-scan found 7 contracts with similar proration pattern, estimated exposure = 119,760. Schedule full reconciliation.

cfo_lucas: include ARR/NRR delta and the JE reference in the close pack. If the sweep confirms material exposure, we need to consider restatement risk and notify external auditors.

hannah.lee: filing BE ticket BE-5123 to change proration behavior: when downgrade mid-cycle, do not accelerate recognition; instead post a deferred credit. Assign to jen.santos.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED BE-5123 - Prevent accelerated recognition on mid-cycle downgrades. Assigned jen.santos.

elaine.ops: creating JE now JE# 3050-MAY-DOWN-002 (pending). Will attach billing log, sweep results, and worksheet.

omar.reed: once JE posts, I'll sign off GL reconciles. Also suggest adding a unit test and an integration test for downgrade scenarios in billing proration flows.

hannah.lee: noted, adding test cases to the ticket. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
